_readme: Hand-maintained inputs to scripts/build_team_registry.py --sport cfb. Never edit cfb_teams.json directly.

names: registry ID -> canonical display name. Pins the pre-registry NORM table's choices that stored 2021-2026 data is keyed by. Changing one RENAMES that team everywhere going forward (stored season files keep the old string) - do it deliberately, never to fix a lookup.
aliases: registry ID -> extra spellings to resolve to that team. Strongest tier: beats any vendor-derived claim on the same spelling.
blocked_aliases: spellings that must never resolve to anything.
